artworks.title: Washington's Headquarters near Valley Forge
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black
artworks.description: The image shows a house surrounded by large trees, viewed from the front. The entrance is slightly off-center to the right. The base of the house implies the horizon. It is characterized by fine lines detailing the foliage and shaded areas. Light and shadow are depicted through crosshatching and sparse lines. The color scheme is monochromatic, using only black ink on a light background. The grass shows shadows cast by the trees. Two large trees flank each side of the house, with branches extending across the top to frame the structure against the sky.

artworks.title: George Washington
artworks.artist: William Edgar Marshall after Gilbert Stuart
artworks.medium: engraving on paperboard
artworks.description: This print shows a black-and-white portrait of a man, depicting his body from the chest upwards. The man is positioned in an oval frame, facing slightly to the left with his head turned towards us. His facial features include pale skin, a prominent nose, thin lips, deep-set eyes, and strong eyebrows. He has curly white hair styled away from his face. He wears a dark, textured, formal coat over a white shirt, with a cravat tied around his neck, layered with lace detailing. The oval portrait is within a gray rectangle.

artworks.title: The Ferry House
artworks.medium: etching

artworks.title: Four-Story House
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image depicts a cluster of tall, intricately detailed buildings seen from street level. The buildings dominate the scene, extending upwards and out of the frame. The etching technique used emphasizes the ornate architectural details and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with dark lines against a light background. The foreground includes the lower parts of buildings, small figures, and trees for scale. In the distance, rows of windows and architectural features define the cityscape.

artworks.title: The Woolworth Building
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image depicts a cityscape with towering skyscrapers. The viewpoint is from street level, looking up towards the buildings. The drawing features precise line work and intricate details of the architectural elements. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray and sepia. Pedestrians and vehicles are suggested by small lines in the foreground. In the distance, the buildings become less detailed, stretching towards the sky textured with soft clouds.

artworks.title: Tracks, Oberhausen
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This print shows an industrial railway yard from an elevated perspective. The view includes railway tracks with several trains on them, industrial structures with smokestacks, and tall cranes. Smoke fills the cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Jungle
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: This image shows an elevated view of a tropical landscape with a river flowing through steep rocky hills and dense forest. A horizon separates the sky from the land, which includes water with small islands. The brushstrokes are loose and sketch-like, emphasizing texture and form. The color palette uses varying shades of gray to suggest depth and emphasize foliage. A railroad track moves through the scene, guiding the eye from the bottom left to the horizon.

artworks.title: Laying the Floor of Pedro Muguel Lock
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: This print depicts a construction site from a low vantage point. The construction includes large walls on the left and right sides of the print and two gates in the center, framed by a crane and scaffolding. The wall on the left has an arched opening near the top. The ground is covered in long beams or planks of wood, on top of which many people walk and work. The people are small and depicted by abstract outlines. The sky above the walls is light gray, with some smudges of dark gray. The background of the print is off-white paper.

artworks.title: The Approach to Gatun Lock
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image shows a construction site with a bridge being built. The view is from above, showing the site, a river, and trees. The brushstrokes are detailed and sketch-like, depicting construction elements with dynamic lines. The color scheme is monochromatic, mainly in shades of gray, black, and white. Concrete structures with scaffolding, iron railway tracks, cranes, and construction work on the bridge are visible. In the background, there is a river, a far shore, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Washington Family
artworks.medium: stipple engraving and engraving on wove paper
artworks.description: This grayscale print depicts a family scene with four people at a table and another person in the background. On the left, an older man with light skin and white hair is seated on an ornate chair with his legs crossed. He has a long nose and thin lips in a neutral expression. He is dressed in what appears to be a military uniform, with a long, buttoned coat over a white shirt and knee-high boots with buckles. He faces the right, and his left arm rests on a table at the center of the print that is covered with a draped black cloth. Upon it are papers, a large map, and a sword. To the left of the seated man, a young boy stands with his hand on a large globe. The boy has light skin, and he is wearing a gray jacket, waistcoat, and breeches. On the other side of the round table, a seated woman faces the left. She has light skin and white hair under a tall white bonnet. She wears an elaborate white gown with gray lace details. She is holding part of the map that is on the table. Standing next to the woman, behind the table, is a young lady with light skin, shown from the knees up in an ornate dress with tight sleeves, holding the edge of the map. On the right, a man stands at the edge of the scene, behind the two women. He has dark skin and black hair pulled back from his face, and he wears an elaborate suit with a high-collared jacket over a buttoned waistcoat and a white shirt. His left hand is tucked inside his jacket. The setting features an elegant room with large, draped curtains and a round column on the left. The partial view of a window or alcove in the background shows trees and a light sky.

artworks.title: Tête-à-tête
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with two people sitting together with a small dog amidst nature. In the center of the drawing, the people are reclining on the ground, surrounded by leaves, tree trunks, and a low wall on the left. The people, a man and a woman, have their arms around one another, the woman sitting partially in the man's lap. They both have light skin and light hair, and she wears a long dress with a low neckline, and he appears to wear a tunic and has a wide-brimmed hat sitting in his lap. Their faces are close together, and they are looking at each other. The surrounding environment includes dense trees and overgrown shrubs, and on the left is a stone wall that appears to be half-built or in ruins, with a small fountain at its center. Near the bottom left corner, a small dog sits by the couple, looking up at them.

artworks.title: Young Woman in Netherlandish Dress
artworks.medium: brush and brown and white ink on gray-violet prepared paper
artworks.description: A woman stands angled to and looking off to the left in this vertical, full-length drawing, which was created with brown and white ink and shaded with washes of the same color on smoky purple-colored paper. The woman has a heart-shaped face with a short, rounded nose, full lips, and a bulb-shaped chin. Her head is covered with a white cloth that drapes to chin length at the sides and falls down her back. The square neckline of her bodice is low, but her chest is covered with a white cloth. The voluminous sleeves are lined with wide, long bands of fur along the cuffs, and she holds her hands clasped in front of her waist. A beaded rosary hangs from her waist, and the deep folds of her heavy skirts fall almost to the floor. The artist signed the drawing near the upper right corner with a capital letter D tucked between the long legs of a letter A. The monogram is below the date, 1521.

artworks.title: The Dismissal of Hagar
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 15.7 x 13.6 cm (6 3/16 x 5 3/8 in.)
support: 20 x 17.2 cm (7 7/8 x 6 3/4 in.)

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray-brown wash
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several people gathered under a simple shelter. The sketch shows figures assembled around a central point under a makeshift canopy. The structure consists of wooden posts supporting a slanted roof. The figures seem engaged in communal activities such as conversation or focused on a task. The artwork uses expressive lines to capture the mood and actions of the subjects. Lighting and shading add depth to the scene, providing a glimpse into a moment of interaction among the individuals.

artworks.title: Angel Standing
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over traces of charcoal on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angel with large wings extending from their back, standing and wearing flowing robes. The angle is in profile, facing the left, and their bare feet are visible on the ground. The angel's head is slightly bowed and their hands are raised. The angel is sketched in brown ink on the off-white paper.

artworks.title: Hagar Seated at the Fountain
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (Right Sh): 13.6 x 9.3 cm (5 3/8 x 3 11/16 in.)
overall (joined Sh): 13.6 x 18.2 cm (5 3/8 x 7 3/16 in.)
overall: 86.3 cm (34 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures interacting with each other. The drawing depicts an angelic figure on the left, sketched with flowing lines, expansive wings, and robes. The figure's head is slightly inclined forward. On the right, a seated figure is drawn with a few lines, appearing to gesture with both arms raised. The seated figure wears a wide-brimmed hat. The drawing suggests a narrative or moment of encounter between the two figures, with a simplistic yet expressive style capturing the essence of the scene.

artworks.title: Christ before Pilate
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink on brown paper
artworks.description: This painting is a loose sketch of a scene with multiple people. In the left, a person appears to sit on a chair or throne, facing the right. This person appears to have a hat or crown on their head. They are surrounded by a group of other people. On the right, two people appear to lead a person between them up some steps towards the seated person. The background is blank. The scene has been painted in thick, dark brown lines on top of light brown paper.

artworks.title: Death and the Miser
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing shows two figures displayed from the waist up. On the right is an elderly person with glasses and a long beard, wearing a loose garment. They have minimal facial features. They are seated at a table, holding an object in one hand, while the other hand is raised near their face. On the left is a skeleton leaning slightly towards the elderly person, appearing to hold a long, thin object, like an arrow or quill. The table in front of them is covered with objects, and more objects are stacked on the right, with what looks like an open chest. The background is a gradient of light brown on the left to cream on the right.

artworks.title: Eliezer and Rebecca at the Well
artworks.artist: workshop of Rembrandt van Rijn (Carel Fabritius?)
artworks.medium: reed pen and brown ink with brown wash and white gouache
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with an interaction between two people, with one who appears to be offering a water container to the other. On the left appears to be a standing woman wearing a wide-brimmed hat. She is looking down and to the right, where a bearded man sits beside her. He is holding a large container up to his mouth, and she appears to be helping him hold the bottom of it. A tall walking stick seems to sit on the ground between them, resting on one of the woman's legs. Behind them seems to be a rocky hill, and to the left and right are the vague outlines of people and animals, although these shapes lack precise detail.

artworks.title: God the Father Supported by Angels
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of multiple loosely sketched human figures in dynamic poses. The main figure is standing upright and interacting with another shorter figure. The drawing style is rough with bold lines, depicting flowing garments. The background is plain with no details except for a signature in the lower left corner that reads "Rembrandt."

artworks.title: Hannah Rejecting the Reproaches of the Prophet Eli
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing shows two individuals across a table from one another. One person is seated in a chair on the left side of the drawing. This person has their back towards us, their face obscured. They have shoulder-length hair and wear a small hat and a long-sleeved garment. Across the small table, another person stands in the center of the drawing, facing the left. This person is leaning one arm on the table and raising their other arm to point at the sitting person. They wear a tall hat or head-covering with two distinct points and a veil draping down around their face. They have on a long, draped dress. An empty chair is behind them, near the bottom right corner of the print. There seem to be some papers or an open book on the table between them, and some lines on the left side suggest walls. The rest of the background is blank, beige paper.

artworks.title: Jacob's Dream
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person lying on the ground, surrounded by dark walls. The person lays in a pool of light coming down from the top-left corner of the drawing, where the legs and feet of two other people are visible. The lines of the drawing are minimal, providing little detail.

artworks.title: Judas Leaving the High Priest
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash on  laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people inside a building with large columns on the right. A group of people is gathered on the left side, facing the right. To the right of center, there is one person at the top of the steps that are between the large columns, appearing to walk down the stairs and away from the group. They are facing us with their hands raised. The drawing features loose lines and minimal details, and it is in shades of gray and brown on off-white paper.

artworks.title: Lot and His Family Leaving Sodom
artworks.medium: pen and light brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an illustration showing a group of people. The scene features several figures, including two central characters who are standing and talking. The figures have simple facial features and hairstyles, and some are wearing headwear such as turbans and hats. They are dressed in robes or loose garments. The background is a lightly sketched landscape with distant architectural elements.
